title: Moosend Review (2026)
intro: Moosend is evaluated here as email marketing software — Moosend is a budget-oriented email marketing and automation platform with landing pages, forms, and workflows. Pricing centers on a Pro contact-tier plan from $9/mo at 500 contacts (research; ~$7/mo annual), plus Moosend+ add-ons and Enterprise custom quotes. No forever-free plan; 30-day trial marketed. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Moosend when budget email automation with unlimited sends on Pro is the priority.
verdict: Choose Moosend when budget email automation with unlimited sends on Pro is the priority. Compare Brevo for send-based free/paid value, GetResponse for all-in-one free-tier paths, ActiveCampaign for deeper automation+CRM, and MailerLite for free-tier ease. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
